primitives.name: Shot Success Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: What is the chance my teammate will successfully execute this shot?
primitives.assumptions: Constant skill level, independent shot execution, no external interference.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when environmental factors (ice bias, temperature) exceed calibration range.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI conformal prediction intervals for shot accuracy.
layer2.telemetry: Historical shot conversion rates by player and shot type.

primitives.name: Win Probability Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sometimes teams may make a clear strategic mistake because they simply don't know the numbers and rely instead on gut or feel.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Dimensionless win probability, $0 \leq P_{win} \leq 1$; $s$: score differential, $h \in \{0,1\}$ hammer indicator, $r$: ends remaining.
primitives.assumptions: Markov property: future outcomes depend only on current state. Stationary transition probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks when opponents exploit non-stationary patterns or psychological fatigue.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition graphs with probabilistic edges.
layer2.telemetry: Simulated game outcomes vs. actual tournament results.

primitives.name: Hammer Advantage
primitives.verbatim_quote: Curling is a game steeped in tradition, where parents and grandparents pass on experience to the next generation.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Dimensionless win probability difference, typically $\Delta P_{hammer} \approx 0.05-0.10$.
primitives.assumptions: Optimal play from both skips, identical team quality, no external noise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Advantage diminishes in extra ends due to defensive blanking strategies.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI binary classification of hammer effectiveness.
layer2.telemetry: Historical win rates conditional on having hammer.

primitives.name: Blank End Strategy
primitives.verbatim_quote: In many instances, some of the best teams in the world stop and consider several options (while a chess timer is ticking away) when pre-planning could help clarify the correct decision much faster.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Objective function maximized over shot sequences, $\text{score} \in \{0,1\}$.
primitives.assumptions: Rational skip, perfect information, no time pressure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when skips prioritize short-term scoring over long-term win probability.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE optimal stopping problems under uncertainty.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of blanked ends vs. expected win probability gains.
